countries.name: Russia
countries.summary: Legal assistance in Russia: corporate and commercial law, international contracts, import-export, sanctions, intellectual property and disputes.
countries.html:
The Circosta Law Firm provides legal assistance in Russia, offering services that combine international expertise with a practical understanding of the local business environment. We advise companies and individuals in corporate and commercial law, supporting them in governance, restructuring and shareholder relations.

Our team has solid experience in international contracts, helping Russian businesses draft and negotiate agreements that comply with both Russian and international standards. Considering Russia's role in global energy, trade and industry, we dedicate particular attention to import-export activities, guiding clients through compliance, cross-border operations and dispute resolution.

Innovation and intellectual property are also key priorities. We assist entrepreneurs and corporations in protecting trademarks, patents and copyrights at the international level, transforming innovation into a sustainable strategic asset for long-term growth.

In addition to these areas, we provide services in financial law, human rights, international trade law, ecclesiastical and canon law, civil and criminal law, criminology and cyber crime. This broad expertise allows us to deliver comprehensive legal solutions for Russian clients, both locally and abroad.

Russia-related matters with a cross-border lens

  • Sanctions compliance, contracts, IP/media, cyber and disputes.
  • OSINT-driven risk assessments and supply-chain due diligence.
  • Confidential, business-oriented counsel for companies, investors and NGOs.
